title: Soteria Pulse
positioning: Soteria Pulse is a compliance service Soteria delivers for your workplace using the Pulse platform. It is not self-serve software, and there is no client sign-up. Soteria uses Pulse to track your AEDs and equipment, keep inspection and training records, and prepare reports for you.

sections.title: AED compliance
sections.intro: AED compliance is the main part of the service.

claims.text: AED and equipment tracking, including pad and battery expiry dates. Soteria keeps these records for your workplace.
Inspection records. Soteria maintains the inspection record for your AEDs.
Readiness assessments and assessment visits. Soteria carries out the assessments and records them in Pulse.

sections.title: Training records and reports
sections.intro: Soteria also keeps training records and prepares reports for you.

claims.text: Certification and first aid/CPR training record tracking. Soteria tracks these records for you.
PDF compliance and executive reports. Soteria prepares the reports and shares them with you.

pricingNote: Subscription pricing is not available yet. Request a demo and Soteria will follow up.
